spans.s: And also the words प्रथम 'first', चर्म 'last', words with the affix तय -- संख्याया अवयवे तयप्‌

, अल्प 'few', अर्ध 'half', कतिपय 'some' and नेम 'half' are optionally सर्वनाम , before the Nominative Plural termination.

Terms: विभक्ति

The disappearance of an affix when it is caused by the words लुक् , श्लु or लुप् are designated by those terms respectively.

Terms:

When elision of an affix has taken place (लोप), the affix still exerts its influence and the operations dependant upon it, take place as if it were present.

Terms:

In (this book, in the sūtras relating to) compound, the word that is exhibited in the Nominative -1st case, is called उपसर्जन or the secondary word.

Terms: उपसर्जन

(Nor need be taught) the rule relating to the dependance of the meaning of a word on the principal (प्रधान in a compound) or on the affix (प्रत्यय) because the authority of the meaning (of a word, compound or derivative) consists in something else.

Terms:

After the verb स्था 'when meaning to indicate one's intentions to another', or 'to make an award as an arbitrator', the आत्मनेपद affix is employed.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the Desideratives of श्रु 'to hear', when preceded by प्रत and आङ् , the आत्मनेपद affix is Not used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb वह् 'to bear', coming after प्र , परस्मैपद is used, even though the fruit of the action accrues to the the agent.

Terms: परस्मैपद

In the case of the verb श्रु preceded by the prepositions प्रति and अङ् and meaning 'to promise', the person to whom promise is made (literally: the person who as the agent of the former verb) is called सम्प्रदान।

Terms: कारक-सम्प्रदान
From this point forward up to the aphorism अधिरीश्वरे

, all that we shall say is to be understood to have the name of निपात or Particles.

Terms: कारक-कर्ता-संज्ञा

The words प्र etc. are called निपात when not signifying susbtances.

Terms: निपात-शब्दाः

The indeclinable word प्रध्वम् followed by the verb कृ , is always called गति when in used in the sense of 'binding'.

Terms: गति-हस्ते

The word प्रति is कर्म -प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of representative ('representative of') or exchange ('in exchange for').

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय

When joke is implied with reference to an action, the verb denoting it is used in the 2nd person; provided that the word मन्य 'to think' is the attendant word (उपपद) of such verb and of the verb मन्य itself, the affix must be of the 1st person and singular number.

Terms:
From this point up to the aphorism कडाराः कर्मधराये

, all the terms that we shall say, describe will get the designation of समास or compound

Terms: समास

A case-inflected word denoting a genus (जाति) is compounded with a word denoting praise and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The words प्राप्त 'obtained', and आपन्न 'obtained' are optionally compounded with words ending in a Second Case-affix and form तत्-पुरुष compound.

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष
The 5th case-affix (Ablative) is used after whatsoever is governed by a कर्मप्रवचनीयाः
in the sense of 'susbtitute' or 'exchange' -- प्रतिः प्रतिनिधिप्रतिदानयोः

.

Terms: विभक्ति-5

In conjunction with the words प्रसिक्त and उत्सुक 'greatly desirous of', the 3rd case-affix is used after the word, as well as the 7th.

Terms: विभक्ति-3, 7
Where the sense is that of the Nominal-stem -- अर्थवदधातुरप्रत्ययः प्रातिपदिकम्

, or of gender only, or measure only or number only, the 1st case-affix is used.

Terms: विभक्ति-1

An affix.

Terms: अधिकार

The word ग्रह 'to seize', preceded by the prepositions प्रति and अपि , takes the affix क्यप् in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: क्यप्-छन्दस्

The word प्रणाय्य is irregularly formed when meaning 'disapproved'.

Terms: Irregular

The affixes लङ् (Imperfect Tense) and लिट् (Perfect Tense) come after a verb (in expressing a past time not belonging to the current day and unperceived by the speaker) when the past referred to is recent and the sentence is interrogative.

Terms: लङ् and लिट्

The affix इनि comes in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' after the verb प्रजु 'to hasten forward'.

Terms: इनि

The affix घञ् comes after the verb स्तॄ 'to cover' when the preposition वि is in composition with it when the sense is that of extension and when such spreading does not refer to words.

Terms: घञ्

The words प्रमद and सम्मद are irregularly formed, meaning 'joy'.

Terms: Irregular

The affix अप् comes after the verb श्रि 'to flow' in the sense of impregnating (the covering of cows etc.).

Terms: अप्

The words 1. प्रयै 2. रोहिष्यै 3. अव्यथिष्यै are irregularly formed Vedic Infinitives.

Terms: Irregular

The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a noun in the Instrumental -3rd case or Locative -7th case is in composition with it and when measure of length is intended.

Terms: णमुल्

In the opinion of the Eastern Grammarians, the affix ष्फ is used after what ends with the affix यञ् and it is to be regarded as a तद्धित-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्
The affix अण् should be understood to come after whatever we shall teach hereafter up to sūtra तेन दीव्यति खनति जयति जितम्

etc.

Terms: अण्

According to the opinion of Eastern Grammarians after a stem not having वृद्धि vowel in the first syllable, the affix फिन् is diversely used in the sense of a descendant.

Terms: फिन्

The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after a word ending with प्रस्थ after the words पलदी etc. and after a word having a penultimate क , whether these words express villages of North folk or not.

Terms: अण्

The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality and ending with 1. प्रस्थ 2. पुर or वह।

Terms: वुञ्

The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after the words beginning with कद denoting the places of the East-folk.

Terms: छ

The affix एण्य comes in the remaining senses after the word प्रावृष।

Terms: एण्य

After the word प्रावृट् being in the Locative -7th case-affix, there is the affix ठप् in the sense of 'produced therein'.

Terms: ठप्

After a word being in construction in the Locative -7th case, an affix (one of those ordained already) comes in the sense of 'generally found therein'.

Terms: विभक्ति-7

After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) which is the Ablative -5th case in construction, an affix (one of those already taught) comes in the sense of 'what appears for the first time'.

Terms: विभक्त-5

The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the words expressing living beings and after रजत etc.

Terms: अञ्
The affix ठक् comes as a governing affix in the senses enumerated hereafter up to sūtra

.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is 'he gives', the motive being mean.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'who takes' after the words 1. प्रतिकण्ठा 2. अर्थ and 3. ललाम being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ठन् and ठक् comes after the word प्रतिपथम् , in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'who goes'.

Terms: ठक्

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose weapon' after a word denoting 'a weapon' and being in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: ठक्
In each sūtra from this one forward to -- तस्मै हितम्

, the affix यत् bears rule.

Terms: यत्

The affix खञ् comes in the sense of 'excellent in regard thereto' after the words प्रतिजन etc.

Terms: खञ्
From this one forward to तेन कृतम्

, the affix छ bears the rule.

Terms:
Up to sutra

(excluding that) the affix ठञ् (+/- इक or +/- क) bears rule.

Terms:

The affix यत् (यं) comes in the sense of 'long standing' after the word काल being the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: यत् (यं)

The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'that whose occasion or purpose is this' after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: ठञ्

The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'nature or action or thereof' after class names of animals and words expressing age as well as after उद्गात्रि etc.

Terms: अञ्

The affixes द्वयसच् , दघ्नश्च and मात्रच् come in the sense of 'that whereof this is the lineal measure' after a word in Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: द्वयसच् , दघ्नश्च and मात्रच्

The affix लच् comes optionally in the sense of मतुप् after a stem ending in long आ the word expressing something which is found only in a living being.

Terms: लच्

The affix ण् comes in the sense of मतुप् after the words 1. प्रज्ञा 2. श्रद्धा and 3. अर्चा as well as the affix मतुप् ।

Terms: ण्
The sūtra taught from this forward up to दिक्‌शब्देभ्यः सप्तमीपञ्चमीप्रथमाभ्यो दिग्देशकालेष्वस्तातिः

(exclusive) are called विभक्ति।

Terms: विभक्ति
The affix थाल् comes after the words किम् etc. -- किंसर्वनामबहुभ्योऽद्व्यादिभ्यः

when we speak of a kind or manner of being.

Terms: थाल्

After an ordinal numeral up to 11 exclusive, comes the affix अन् , the word retaining its denotation when a 'part' is meant, but not so in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: अन्

For प्रशस्य is substituted श्र when the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow.

Terms: इष्ठन् and इयसुन्

The affix रूपप्‌ comes without a change of connotation after a stem - nominal or verbal, denoting 'praise'.

Terms: रूपप्‌

The affix जातीयर् (जातीय) comes after a case-inflected word which expresses 'a speciality'.

Terms: जातीयर् (जातीय)
The affix क governs all sūtras as far as इवे प्रतिकृतौ

.

Terms: क

According to the opinion of Eastern Grammarians the affixes अडच् and वुच् also come after a human name beginning with the word उप।

Terms: अडच् and वुच्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix थाल् comes in the sense of 'like this' after 1. प्रत्न 2. पूर्व 3. विश्व and 4. इम (इदम्).

Terms: थाल्

The affix अण् comes after the words प्रज्ञ etc. (the words retaining their sense).

Terms: अण्

The affix तसि comes after that Ablative -5th case which is ordained owing to the union with the कर्मप्रवचनीय word प्रति।

Terms: तसि

The affix अच् comes after the word उरस् when it follows the word प्रति in a compound and has the sense of the Locative.

Terms: अच्

After the words प्र and सम् there is the substitution of ज्ञु for जानु when forming the बहुव्रीहि समास ।

Terms:

There is vocalisation of श्या preceded by the उपसर्ग प्रति , when the निष्ठा affixes follow.

Terms:

There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the dipthong of the root वी in the causative, when meaning 'to conceive an embryo'.

Terms: धातु-चि-स्फुर्

For the simple vowel of a nominal-stem and for the vowel of the case-affixes of the Nominative and the Accusative in all numbers, there is the single substitution of a long vowel corresponding to the first vowel.

Terms: संहितायाम्

The final ए or ओ and the following अ when occuring in the middle half of a foot of a Vedic verse, retain their original forms, except when the अ is followed by ख् or य्।

Terms: संहितायाम्

To the root कश् 'to go, to punish', is added the augment सुट् , when preceded by the preposition प्रति , the form being प्रतिष्कशः।

Terms: सुट् augment

The words प्रस्कण्व and हरिश्चन्द्र are formed by सुट् meaning the two Rishis of that name.

Terms: सुट् augment

In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the words चिर or कृच्छ्र as its second member, the first member, when it denotes that which experiences an obstacle, preserves its original accent.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

The word प्रथम when first in a compound optionally retains its original accent when meaning 'a novice'.

Terms: समास accent

A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in affix अक and which denotes the sport of the Eastern people, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

Terms: समास 1st-acute

The first member which has not a वृद्धि in the first syllable or which is not कर्की etc. gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before प्रस्थ।

Terms: समास 1st-acute

The word भगाल at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

The word प्रवृद्ध etc. ending in क्त have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

After प्र a, a word which does not denote a part of the body has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the compound is a name.

Terms:

In a तत्-पुरुष समास the words अंशु etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by प्रति।

Terms:

The Locative -7th case-affix ending is retained after 1. प्रावट् 2. काल and 3. दिव् when ज follows.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision

The word सह retains its original form when the sentence denotes benediction, except when it is गो , वत्स or हल।

Terms: स Substitute

A monosyllabic भ अङ्ग (stem) retains its original form without undergoing any change before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् ।

Terms: प्रकृति भाव

The irregularly formed परिवृढ means 'Lord'.

Terms: Irregular

आ is substituted for the final of युष्मद् and अस्मद् before the case-ending of the Nominative 1st-Case dual in the secular literature.

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्

त्व is substituted for युष्म् and म for अस्म् when they signify a single individual, even when an affix follows or a word is in composition.

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्

After a word denoting direction, the first vowel of the name of a village or city in the land of the Eastern people, gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् ।

Terms: वृद्धि

Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowels of both members of the compound which is the name of a city of the Eastern people and which ends in the word नगर।

Terms: वृद्धि

Before the affix ढ (एय), the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the second member of प्रवाहण but optionally so for the first member (i.e. प्र).

Terms: वृद्धि

इ is substituted for the अ which stands before the क् belonging to an affix when the feminine ending आ follows, provided that, it does not come after a case-affix (i.e. when such a word in अक does not stand at the end of a बहुव्रीहि समास).

Terms: Feminine इ

प्रयाज and अनुयाज are irregularly formed with घञ् when meaning 'a portion of a sacrificial offering'.

Terms: Guttarlisation

प्रयोज्य and नियोज्य preserve their palatal in the sense of 'capable to do this'.

Terms: Guttarlisation

1. प्र 2. सम् 3. उ and 4. उत् are repeated when by so doubling, the foot of a verse is completed.

Terms: Doubling of Words

An adjective is repeated, when it is meant to express that the said attribute belongs to a thing only to a limited degree and the double word is treated like a कर्मधारय समास ।

Terms: Doubling of Words

म is optionally substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root स्तयै preceded by प्र।

Terms: निष्ठा changes

In answer to a salutation, but not when it refers to शुद्र , the last vowel of a sentence becomes प्लुत and gets an acute accent (उदात्त).

Terms: प्लुत

In a sacrificial work ओ3म् is substituted for the final vowel with the consonant, if any, that may follow it, in a sentence.

Terms: प्लुत

The end syllable of the sentence which expresses assent or promise or listening to, is प्लुत।

Terms: प्लुत
(The substitution of ष् for स् to be taught hereafter, will take place) for all roots up to सित् exclusive in परिनिविभ्यः सेवसितसयसिवुसहसुट्स्तुस्वञ्जाम्

, even when the augment अट् intervenes (between the स and the efficient letter).

Terms: षत्व change

The word प्रष्ठ is irregularly formed when denoting 'a chief' or 'one who goes in front'.

Terms: ष change

The words प्रतिस्तब्ध and निस्तब्ध are anomalous.

Terms: षत्व change

The न of वन , is replaced by ण , even when the compound is not a Name, when it is preceded by the words प्र , निर् , अन्तर , शर , इक्षु , प्लक्ष , आम्र , कार्ष्य , खदिर and पीयूक्षा।

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-समास

Optionally ण is substituted for न when it stands at the end of a Nominal-stem (प्रातिपदिक) or is the augment नुम् or is न of a case-affix, (when the cause of change occurs in the first member of the compound).

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-समास-word
